messages:
Maya Nguyen: Hey folks — idea: vinyl swap + tapas night at the office kitchen next Friday? bring a record and one tapas/snack to share. low-key, BYO-plate. 🎶🥘
Jordan Lee: love this. what time were you thinking? after 6?
Maya Nguyen: thinking 6:30pm so people can wrap up. kitchen table + record player in the lounge.
Samir Patel: count me in. I’ll bring a flamenco-ish record and some manchego + quince.
Olivia Chen: can do 6:30. i’ll bring patatas bravas and a small speaker adapter. need any extension cords?
Diego Morales: i can bring a cheesy smörgås experiment.  also can anyone bring an extra record sleeve? mine are full. :laughing:
Kai Brooks: i’ll bring a handful of tapas and a copy of the Sex Pistols record for variety. 😂
Riley Park: excited — will be there. can we do a 10-minute “show-and-play” where each person explains why they picked the record? optional ofc.
Maya Nguyen: love the mini-showcase idea. keep it casual, no pressure.
Jordan Lee: poll: drop a reaction — 👍 if you can make it, 👎 if can’t, :shrug: if maybe.
OpsBot: Meeting reminder set: Vinyl & Tapas — Friday 18:30 in Lounge (auto-reminder 1 hour before).
Olivia Chen: 👍
Samir Patel: 👍
Diego Morales: 👍
Kai Brooks: 👍
Riley Park: 👍
Jordan Lee: also small ask — label any food with allergens? peanuts/tree nuts/vegan etc.
Maya Nguyen: yep will put a little sign. i’ll bring labels and markers.
Olivia Chen: i’m vegan — i’ll mark mine as vegan + gluten-free.
Samir Patel: quick logistics — is parking still limited after 6:30? i might carpool.
Jordan Lee: garage closes at 8 but we can request extended sign-in for guests if needed.
Maya Nguyen: if anyone needs a vinyl sleeve, i have a pack. drop me a DM.
Diego Morales: also bringing a tiny bluetooth turntable adapter.
Riley Park: perfect. should we set a cap on people so it doesn’t spill into the whole office? maybe 25?
Maya Nguyen: good call — let’s cap at 25. if more want in we can move to the rooftop next time.
Jordan Lee: RSVP list so far: Maya, Jordan, Samir, Olivia, Diego, Kai, Riley — 7. we’re well under 25.
Maya Nguyen: awesome. see you all Friday! feel free to add song recs below so we can playlist in advance.
Samir Patel: rec: Paco de Lucía — "Entre dos aguas"
Olivia Chen: rec: Arca — "Piel"
Kai Brooks: rec: The Clash — "London Calling"
Diego Morales: rec: Buena Vista Social Club — "Chan Chan"
Jordan Lee: rec: Talking Heads — "This Must Be the Place"
Maya Nguyen: cool mix. thanks everyone — planning note: I’ll put out plates/cutlery and a little sign for dietary labels. :sparkles:
